decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with its own product page and little sunk cost; it fits the trailer range and gives no visible reason to withdraw it after only one year.
Featuring the series on the home page is a public commitment to a core product line, so after a single year management would blame any weak results on start-up effects and persist.
Development and tooling for a car transporter are substantial sunk costs, and its own product page shows commitment, so management would give it more time to establish itself.
The low-bed series is shown on the home page and central to the firm's trailer portfolio, so prior investment and visibility favour continuing it.
The cover series sits on the home page as part of the announced range, and it is too early to call results anything other than temporary.
A second box trailer series also highlighted on the home page reflects deliberate range expansion, and it would be kept despite some possible overlap with B.
